main_text.l: nimo sedet immotus verus hic & praecla-
rus versiculus, καλλιςόν ἐςι χρῆμα παι-δείας βροτοῖς.
Verum Epistolii modus illius laudibus finem imponere cogit,
qvi de litteris, litteratisqve omnibus
be-ne merendi finem nunquam facit. Unum
mihi superest, ut qva sum in te observan-
tia & obseqvio, in haec vota precesqve
non cessem; te, tuamqve dignitatem ad
Ecclesiae salutem, Deus Opt. Max. &
conservet diutissime, & meritis honori-
bus augeat, cumuletqve qvam citisime.
Vale, Reverendisime Praesul, & me tui
observantissimum amare perge.
EPIST. XL.
R. Goesaldus J. Morino, quod praeter al-
lata notent Romani Aulici in ejus
Libro De la Grandeur, &c. scribit.
LA Grace de Jesus pour jamais. J'ay
donné vostre lettre à Monseigneur
Suarez.

page.notes: The Greek words are copied as printed; the accents and the final letters of καλλιςόν and ἐςι are read from a small scan and could not be fully confirmed. The summary line under EPIST. XL. is set in roman type and is treated as a level 2 heading. The letter continues on the next page.
